blurb: Jason Goepfert is the founder of SentimenTrader (sentimentrader.com), a quantitative research service specializing in market sentiment analysis and historical pattern studies. He is widely cited in financial media for his work on investor sentiment indicators — put/call ratios, fund flows, breadth data, and crowd-behavior extremes. His posts blend rigorous historical backtests with real-time market observations, aimed at identifying when sentiment has reached actionable extremes. He has tens of thousands of followers among traders, portfolio managers, and financial journalists.
credibility_note: Goepfert has a long track record of publishing reproducible, data-backed research rather than narrative-driven calls, which gives him high credibility in the quant/sentiment community. His work is generally descriptive and probabilistic rather than directional prediction, so 'miss' claims are less applicable; no major public controversies or corrections are on record.
